title: IMPLEMENT Astro v7 + Express API Hybrid Architecture
content:
**What**: Migrated frontend presentation layer to Astro Framework (v7.1+) with React 19 Islands and Tailwind CSS v4 while retaining Node.js Express + PostgreSQL 18.4 as the backend REST API.
**Why**: Provides maximum page loading speed (SSR HTML output) alongside dynamic client-side interactivity for high-frequency POS cashier billing.
**Where**: `astro.config.mjs`, `src/pages/`, `src/components/`, `src/lib/db.js`.
**Learned**: Vite SSR bundler requires pure ESM database connectors (`src/lib/db.js` using `import pg from 'pg'`) to avoid `require is not defined` errors during server-side execution.
